scope: Shared project engine core/decoder/scheduler and production Speeduino loop execute against identical independent copies of an uncalibrated research plant; virtual GPIO only

speeduino_profile.rev_limit: protection BOTH and FIXED hard mode enabled/read back; hard6500, soft6200-relative10deg, soft timeout25.5s; project uses ramp/hysteresis
speeduino_profile.sensor_cadence: upstream production polling with ADC quantization; stopped defaults retained

limitations: native Speeduino uint32 4us timers, not AVR timer emulation
zero CPU cost; timers before coincident teeth; project1ms control/native250us loop plus tooth calls
callback injection does not validate wiring or trigger edge dispatch
MSL/MVEM intake research components; local empirical and uncalibrated combustion/coil/fuel/shaft parameters
fixed exhaust pressure, simplified valve events and no calibrated cold/knock/emissions behavior
overrev includes explicit70Nm motoring dynamometer from6.0..6.25s; its work is booked as negative load work
native spark errors use last sampled demand; project uses event-latched demand
termination low is explicit halt/cut, not evidence of natural stall shutdown

content.scope: NA manifold/air flow only; external free shaft and empirical pulse-driven combustion

content.execution: production setup, loop, decoder and schedulers in native process
hal_changes: replace wall-clock timer implementation with deterministic single-thread HAL
drive production oneMSInterval every 1000 virtual microseconds
limits: zero CPU execution cost; explicit main-loop cadence
inject primary decoder callback directly; native fake interrupt wiring not tested
timer callbacks before coincident tooth callback, then production loop
fast PORT outputs observed after each4us timer tick and loop call
